post.author_description: Always in service of His Majesty

description.description: A set of four consecutive frames from a video showing a scene between three actors in a dark setting, with overlay text claiming the movie was released 5 years before 9/11. The sequence starts with Samuel L. Jackson's character questioning someone about faking a terrorist act for funding. The following frames show two other characters (a man in a suit and a blonde woman) discussing that there is no way to fake killing 4000 people and deciding they must do it for real to secure their funding.
description.ocrText: This movie was released 5 years before 9 / 11. tufaha.falastinia. You're gonna fake some terrorist thing just to scare some money out of Congress? ... I have no idea how to fake killing 4000 people. So we're just gonna have to do it for real. Then I get my funding.

tweetMedia.transcription: You're telling me that you're gonna fake some terrorist thing just to get some money out of Congress? Well, unfortunately, Mr. Hennessy, I have no idea how to fake killing 4,000 people. So we're just gonna have to do it for real. Don't blame it on the Muslims, naturally. Then I get my funding. Good night, old girl. Timothy Albion, Sharper One.
